title: Templates
description:
Code templates of the implementation entries: `simd_ext/<isa>/<isa>_native_templates.json`, `simd_ext/<isa>/<isa>_emu_templates.json`, and the generic `helpers_headers/generic_emu_templates.json`, `generic_emu_templates_mask.json` and `generic_emu_templates_lmulh.json`. A template is rendered once per function, datatype and LMUL with Jinja2 (`{{ isa.prefix }}`, `{{ instr_name }}`, `{{ isa_dt_par.data_ext }}`, ...) and with the MIPP placeholders of the [templating DSL](../templating_dsl.md) (`%add<tp>%`, `%r<tp>%`, ...). The MIPP calls of a template are the dependencies of its entries.

ISA entries refer to a template by name (`template`), generic entries with a prefix (`template_ref`: `tpl_generic_emu.<name>`, `tpl_mask_generic_emu.<name>`, `tpl_horiz_lmul_generic_emu.<name>`). A template that no entry uses gets a `dead-code` warning.

code: recp.r = vmulq_{{ isa_dt_par.data_ext }}(recp.r, vrecpsq_{{ isa_dt_par.data_ext }}(r1.r, recp.r));

additionalProperties.description: A template, or a group of templates (accepted, unused).

format.description: `short` (default): `code` is the expression of the result; the generator declares `res`, assigns `res.r` (or `res.m`) and returns it. `long`: `code` is the whole body of the function.

code.description: Code, as a string or a list of lines.
